dataset: NASA NEX-GDDP-CMIP6 (Thrasher et al. 2022), daily, bias-corrected and downscaled to 0.25°, used at 1°

hotDays.label: Unusually hot days per year (for the time of year)

heavyDays.label: Very heavy rain days per year

wetMonsoon.label: A monsoon as wet as today's 1-in-10 wettest

hotYear.label: A year as hot as today's 1-in-10 hottest
